claims.claim: Compartment-resolved pool and flux variables can be represented in a typed cellular state.
Ethanol is the normal mitochondrial product of glucose plus oxygen.
claims.replacement: Aerobic mitochondria oxidize carbon through TCA/OXPHOS; ethanolic fermentation is a distinct route.

claims.claim: Plant hypoxia promotes fermentative NAD+ regeneration when OXPHOS is constrained.
Golgi trafficking/glycosylation and plant polysaccharide functions are distinct organellar channels.
N/P/S and Na+/Cl- have separable biological transport/metabolic roles.
Melanization can alter fungal radiation survival/growth/redox response.
Melanin quantitatively harvests ionizing radiation with a defined biological energy yield.
claims.gap: Need calorimetry/electron/redox energy balance and replication.

claims.claim: Triboluminescent adhesive-tape experiments can emit X-rays under controlled vacuum/material conditions.
Ordinary animal/plant cellular deformation emits triboluminescent X-rays.
Flux-resolved N/P/S/redox models outperform static carbon/ATP pools.
claims.falsifier: No reproducible out-of-sample improvement after complexity penalty.

claims.claim: Chernobyl radiotropism/melanin evidence can be treated as a generic radiotrophic-bacteria mechanism.
claims.replacement: Melanized fungi provide the classic melanin/radiotropism evidence; radioresistant bacteria require a separate mechanism and evidence chain.

claims.claim: Arcalion is sulbutiamine, synthetic B1 derivative; fatigue/asthenia indication does not establish a will/motivation mechanism.
Sulbutiamine independently changes human effort/vigor/action selection after placebo and fatigue controls.
Dopamine/basal-ganglia circuits contribute to effort allocation, action selection and vigor, distinct from cellular ATP sufficiency.
RO, ED and RED are one reversible process.
claims.replacement: Preserve pressure, electrical and salinity-gradient driving forces separately.

claims.claim: EC, KH/alkalinity and pH are equivalent observables.
Cold-induced BAT activation can raise energy expenditure and improve glucose handling in selected human studies.
BAT activation universally reverses insulin resistance.
Magnesium supplementation improves insulin resistance; effect depends on population/baseline and is not universal.
B12 deficiency affects mitochondrial/one-carbon and neurological function; replacement evidence is strongest for deficiency.
Omega-3 may alter stress/cortisol/anxiety endpoints in some trials, with low-certainty heterogeneous evidence.
Omega-3/omega-6 ratio is a universal insulin-sensitivity controller.
Fat-quality substitution may matter more than a simple omega ratio.
